label: c000
English: Ah! Nothing beats the taste of home!
French:
Ah ! Rien ne vaut le goût de la cuisine
de chez soi !
German:
Aaah! Zu Hause schmeckt's
halt doch am Besten!
Spanish: No hay nada como el sabor del hogar.
Turkish: Ah! Ev yemeğinin tadı bir başka!

label: c002
English: I could eat till I'm stuffed!
French:
Je vais manger jusqu'à ce que mon
estomac soit plein !

label: d001
English: I could eat anything now after being away!
French:
Après avoir autant voyagé, je pourrais
manger n'importe quoi !
German:
Auf Reisen habe ich's mir abgewöhnt,
beim Essen wählerisch zu sein!
Italian:
Da quando sono di nuovo a casa riesco
a mangiare di tutto!
Spanish:
¡Después de viajar tanto, ya no le hago
ascos a la comida!
Turkish:
Bunca yolculuktan sonra
artık her şeyi yiyebilirim!

label: d002
English: I still have room for more!
